name: Ouma Petit ☆ Kaitouden
source:
Demons are actually real. They can take human form and infiltrate human society. 
Main character studies at a mission-based school in Yokohama that's rumored to contain hand of a legendary demon in its basement. There are various forces trying to revive the demon. Can protagonist prevent that?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
恶魔其实真实存在。它们能化为人形，潜入人类社会。
主人公就读于横滨一所任务制学校。据说学校地下室封印着传奇恶魔的一只手。多股势力正试图让恶魔复活，主人公能阻止他们吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
